# convex_deployment (Data Source)

Looks up a cloud deployment, either by name or by picking one out of a project.

Set `name`, or set `project_id` together with one of `reference`, `default_prod` or `default_dev`.

To find a deployment starting from a project slug, resolve the project with the `convex_project` data source first and pass its `id` here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name, when you already know it.
data "convex_deployment" "by_name" {
  name = "playful-otter-123"
}

# Or pick one out of a project. There is no team+slug lookup for deployments:
# resolve the project first and pass its id here.
data "convex_project" "app" {
  team_slug = "my-team"
  slug      = "my-application"
}

# Exactly one selector is required -- a project usually holds several
# deployments, so there is nothing sensible to default to.
data "convex_deployment" "prod" {
  project_id   = data.convex_project.app.id
  default_prod = true
}

data "convex_deployment" "prod_us" {
  project_id = data.convex_project.app.id
  reference  = "prod-us"
}

# default_dev resolves against whoever's token is in use, so this returns a
# different deployment for a developer's PAT than for a team token in CI.
# Prefer a reference when you need a stable answer.
data "convex_deployment" "mine" {
  project_id  = data.convex_project.app.id
  default_dev = true
}

output "prod_url" {
  value = data.convex_deployment.prod.deployment_url
}

output "prod_region" {
  value = data.convex_deployment.prod.region
}

# Null when the deployment-type default applies rather than an explicit
# override.
output "prod_sends_logs_to_client" {
  value = data.convex_deployment.prod.send_logs_to_client
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_dev` (Boolean) Select the calling member's default development deployment in the project. Which deployment this resolves to depends on the token in use.
- `default_prod` (Boolean) Select the project's default production deployment.
- `name` (String) Readable identifier of the deployment, such as `playful-otter-123`. Set this to look the deployment up directly.
- `project_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the project to search. Combine with `reference`, `default_prod` or `default_dev`.
- `reference` (String) Select the deployment with this reference within `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `class` (String) Deployment class, for example `s16`.
- `create_time` (Number) Creation timestamp, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `creator` (Number) Numeric member ID of whoever created the deployment.
- `dashboard_edit_confirmation` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard asks for confirmation before edits, or null when the deployment-type default applies.
- `deployment_type` (String) Type of the deployment: `dev`, `prod`, `preview` or `custom`.
- `deployment_url` (String) Backend URL of the deployment.
- `expires_at` (Number) Timestamp in milliseconds at which Convex deletes this deployment, if an expiry is set.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the deployment.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default deployment of its type for the project.
- `last_deploy_time` (Number) Timestamp of the last push to this deployment, or null if nothing has been deployed yet.
- `preview_identifier` (String) Preview identifier, set only on `preview` deployments.
- `region` (String) Hosting region of the deployment.
- `send_logs_to_client` (Boolean) Whether function logs are sent to the client, or null when the deployment-type default applies.
